caption: The drawing is composed in grayscale and depicts the symmetrical front facade of a building with classical architectural elements. The structure has a gabled roof with a rectangular shape. At the center, there is a main arched doorway topped with a semicircular window insert, flanked by two decorative columns and pilasters. Above the entrance is a small centered niche with a triangular pediment, and at the topmost part of the building there is a radiating decorative fan motif. On either side of the central doorway, there are two recessed niches, each set within a rectangular frame with decorative tops featuring swirling motifs. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a ribbon-like banner with the text "1777 mission santa clara" written in a simple font. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing attention on the building's facade.
title: Mision Santa Clara
